name: Circle Game 1
summary:
Have you ever wanted to be a circle? Well, your dream has come true in Circle Game! In this cartoonish and fun game, there are very silly and non-serious places you can visit. Such as: a forest, a beach, a very cool credit room, a hamster cage, and a mysterious cave...

As circle game 1 comes to an end.. we've created a gallery to show all update art, funny moments, and trailers for previous updates!

Join the discord for development updates and stupid fun overall!: 
https://discord.gg/VNs8KsDS4W
